CA.rationale: Content (red mapping) is explicitly bound to a processing/origin record (command_estimate) for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: The referent has an explicit content mapping (red), an explicit organization/origin label (native_conditional_record), and an explicit status flag (executed_branch_claim:false) tied to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: An explicit processing/origin record (command_estimate/feedback_through) is linked to the content referent, indicating a processing condition tied to the content's emergence/access.

C.rationale: The text explicitly identifies multiple content referents with attributes (red mappings) and coordinates.

D.rationale: The origin field separates a status flag (executed_branch_claim:false) from the content mapping, distinguishing identity from execution/status.

O.rationale: The report states how coordinates are oriented (display property) and labels record kinds (native_conditional_record) that describe how content is organized/presented.
